title: I Lost $120k, Then Made $1 Million with This SaaS Idea…
promo_conflict: Founder of Link Whisper talking about his own product.

idea.name: Link Whisper: WordPress internal-linking SEO plugin
idea.one_liner: Bootstrapped WordPress plugin that suggests internal links for SEO, built as a cheap offshore MVP and launched to an existing email audience at a low annual price

key_quotes.quote: In fact, I went to WordPress.org and I looked at Yoast SEO to see how many free downloads their plugin has, because that's people that are interested in SEO and they're on WordPress.
I came in low and I knew if I got buyers at that price, they might be willing to sustain a higher price after that.

claims.claim: MVP cost a few thousand dollars offshore
claims.quote: In addition, I went ahead and I hired an overseas-based developer for a few thousand dollars to get an MVP out the door.
Link Whisper did $30,000 in its very first month.
Instead of doing something like $47, $67, or even $97 per month, my launch pricing was just $47 per year.
I've always taken this bootstrappers mindset and I've now made over a million dollars with Link Whisper in sales.

acquisition_channels.details: launch to Niche Pursuits / Long Tail Pro audience

stated_problem.quote: But what I realized is that there were also a lot of WordPress plugins or other tools that you could use, so you could create a comparison table for free.
stated_problem.speaker: Spencer Haws

idea.name: Table Labs: Amazon affiliate product comparison table builder (failed)
idea.one_liner: SaaS that builds sortable product comparison tables with prices, ratings and features for Amazon affiliate sites; flopped due to free alternatives and high pricing

key_quotes.quote: Over a period of three years, I only made $50,000, $50,000 back in my pocket out of that $120,000 investment.

claims.quote: and in fact, I invested $120,000 building Table Labs that was mostly in software development.
In fact, the first three days, I think the first week, this launch period where I was hoping to make a ton of money, I made a total of $1400.
I was charging as much as 67 or 77, or even $97 a month, depending on the package that you wanted, and people just were not willing to pay that much.
